name: sdaintai-pipo-rfc-mcp-server
description: MCP server exposing PI8 (PJ2) PI/PO HTTP reachability + real ESR object enumeration, plus generic SAP RFC/BAPI calls scoped to SDAINTAI (SDADATAAI reserved for later). Deployed standalone on Cloud Foundry; called by btp_cockpit.html directly over HTTP, and by any MCP client over Basic Auth.
